because: The surfaces of the three verifiable negatives of ADR-0056 D5. A negative holds only when the diff touches none of its surface; any contact makes it unverifiable, and the pull request does not declare it (the line is optional). Read by tools/quality/check-pr-negatives.ts at the MERGE BASE of the pull request, never from its head. Every pattern is a regular expression over the repository-relative path and every name is compared case-insensitively.

workflow.because: A path added or type-changed at or under the directory is a workflow added (a rename is an addition: the list is read with --no-renames). A symlink added or modified at or under .github can make GitHub read any target as a workflow or action.

schema.because: Names: the .schema suffix in JSON or YAML (320 tracked .schema.json paths over the 22 unarchived libre-ai repositories on 2026-10-23, fixtures excluded), the bare schema.json|yaml|yml, and any JSON or YAML file under a schema/ or schemas/ directory. Content: a raw byte search, no parse, for $schema and the two escapes a JSON or YAML string can write it with; a tsconfig or a Biome configuration carrying $schema is a contact, and the author does not declare the negative.

dependency.because: Every manifest and lockfile known to the fleet's ecosystems, the requirements and constraints files, the registry configurations (.npmrc, .yarnrc, .yarnrc.yml, bunfig.toml, .cargo/, pip.conf), .gitmodules, and the workflow and action directories where `uses:` lives. Gitlinks and symlinks are on the surface by mode, in the gate's logic, not by name. Any status counts, both sides of a rename included.
